page.overview:
Who is Wolf?

Wolf was a combatant in the Battle Nexus Tournament. He was defeated in Tier 1 by .

When the Daimyo began the first tier of the competition, walls lifted separating combatants into pairs. Splinter found himself facing Wolf, a large alien armed with a spiked club. Wolf attacks, swinging the club at Splinter, who easily dodges every attempted strike. Splinter then leaps and kicks the club out of Wolf's hands, surprising the fighter. Before he can react, Splinter leaps again to kick Wolf several times in the stomach. Wolf hits the ground hard and is teleported away, leaving Splinter the victor of their match.
